        power[i] = (power[i - 1] * k) % p;

    vector<bool> visited(p, false);
    for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        if (!visited[i]) {

            if (power[length] == 1)

        }
    }

    cout << result;
    return 0;
}
